title: Incident
description: One normalized traffic incident of the trafico-cli JSON contract (schema_version 1, docs/ARRANQUE.md section 4.1 as corrected by docs/feeds.md sections 4.3-4.7). Every field is always present; values the feed does not carry serialise as null (principle P-04): nothing is invented.

schema_version.description: Version of the output contract (P-09). Schema changes land in a dedicated PR with a schema_version bump.

id.description: Stable identifier: the prefix "dgt:" followed by the DATEX II situation record id (sit:situationRecord/@id), the unit that carries location and cause (docs/feeds.md section 4.3).

situation_id.description: Identifier of the parent DATEX II situation (sit:situation/@id). One situation can hold several records, so the record id alone is not the whole story.

source.description: Data source. Always "dgt": the DGT Punto de Acceso Nacional is the only incident feed in v1.

source_version.description: DATEX II model base version of the source feed ("3" for the v3.7 incident payload, docs/feeds.md section 1.1).

type.description: Normalised incident type resolved from the DATEX II cause through internal/datex2/mapping.yaml. Unmapped future causes degrade to "other".

subtype_raw.description: Original DATEX II cause value, never normalised (P-04): the value of the sit:detailedCauseType child when the feed publishes one, otherwise the sit:causeType. This is the preservation point for the source wording the feed lacks as free text.

severity.description: Severity published by the DGT, mapped to low|medium|high. The value "unknown" means the DGT publishes none for the record (about 87% of the feed, docs/feeds.md section 4.5): it is not a low severity and it is never inferred from the cause.

status.description: Computed from the validity window at query time, never from the feed's validityStatus string: "planned" when the start is in the future, "ended" when the end is in the past, otherwise "active".

road.description: Road name normalised by internal/road: trimmed, whitespace collapsed, uppercased, and exactly one hyphen inserted only when the name is a letter prefix followed by a number (a7, "A 7" and a-7 all become A-7). Names that already carry a hyphen keep their structure and suffixes (N-332A, A-356R1, CG-1.5); free-text names are preserved apart from case and whitespace, with no invented hyphen (GC-1 AM, CHG-1, CV PRIVADO IBERDROLA, AVDA. ANDALUCÍA).

direction.description: Direction of travel from lse:tpegDirectionRoad (docs/feeds.md section 4.4). Null when the feed omits it. The compass bearing is a separate field: direction_bearing.

direction_bearing.description: Compass bearing from loc:tpegDirection (westBound, northEastBound, ...), exactly as the feed publishes it, including DATEX II's "unknown". It is a geographic heading, NOT a destination label: the incident feed carries no destination text (docs/feeds.md sections 4.3 and 4.4). Null when absent.

from.description: Kilometre point where the affected stretch begins; null for a single-point location.

to.description: Kilometre point where the affected stretch ends; null for a single-point location.

pk.description: Kilometre-point interval in kilometres with decimals. Either bound is null when the record is a single point; pk itself is null when the record carries no kilometre point at all.

start.description: Coordinates of the first affected point; null when absent.

end.description: Coordinates of the last affected point; null for a single-point location.

province.description: Province exactly as published (P-04). The feed mixes case and bilingual pairs such as "Lugo", "LUGO" and "Alacant/Alicante" (docs/feeds.md section 4.6); filters fold case and accents and match either half of a pair.

location.description: Geographic context. "end" is null for point locations. There is no geocoding in v1: province and municipality only appear when the feed carries them.

lanes_affected.description: Raw loc:laneUsage values of the affected lanes (rightLane, leftLane, allLanesCompleteCarriageway, middleLane, tidalFlowLane, centralReservation, turningLane, carPoolLane, _extended, ...), kept verbatim: the DATEX II list is open, so unknown values are preserved, not filtered. This is a deviation from the section 4.1 sketch ("1 de 3"): the feed has no lane total, only which lanes are affected (docs/feeds.md section 4.3). Null when the record lists no lanes.

start_time.description: Validity start (com:overallStartTime) in RFC3339 UTC. Present in 100% of records.

end_time.description: Planned validity end (com:overallEndTime) in RFC3339 UTC; null when the feed carries none (about 35% of records).

raw_description.description: Free text published by the DGT. Always null today: the incident feed carries no free-text field (docs/feeds.md section 4.3); the original cause wording is preserved in subtype_raw. The field stays in the contract so the DGT adding one is not a breaking change.

updated_at.description: Last version time of the record (sit:situationRecordVersionTime) in RFC3339 UTC.
